facts.claim: NVIDIA independently names Infleqtion among QPU makers and laboratories already using CUDA-Q Logical, an open orchestration layer for designing and testing fault-tolerant quantum-computing applications.
facts.interpretation: This independently corroborates Infleqtion's participation in the CUDA-Q Logical ecosystem without relying on the issuer-origin announcement already present in the packet. It supports ecosystem integration/execution evidence but does not independently verify Infleqtion's 30-logical-qubit target or customer economics.

risks: Being named as a CUDA-Q Logical user does not establish commercial revenue, fault-tolerant hardware readiness, or economic quantum advantage.
unknowns: Independent verification of Infleqtion's targeted 30 logical qubits remains open.
Commercial economics attributable to CUDA-Q Logical integration remain unverified.
